newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank repo allocates seven bln skr to market.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank repo allocates seven bln skr to market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it injected seven billion crowns into the market in this morning's weekly repurchase operation.
The repurchase rate was set at a fixed rate of 4.10 percent, unchanged from last week's rate.
It will run from June 4 to June 11 and replaces an operation which allocated seven billion crowns to the market.
The Riksbank said 18.32 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated.
